title: refactor(git): file-tree menu items carry an Action enum
body: Land already-written commit 1bdb8dc (on branch card/roppgq; card roppgq is Done so the queue refuses it). Steps: git cherry-pick 1bdb8dc; amend the message so its trailer reads 'Card: <this card id>' instead of 'Card: roppgq'; cargo build + cargo test; then integrate + wait as your close-out says. No other changes. If the cherry-pick conflicts, block with the conflict.
